usage: batch_run.py [-h] --run-dir RUN_DIR --manifest MANIFEST
                    [--concurrency CONCURRENCY]

Run a fixed, bounded set of ordinary dispatch attempts.

The batch owner validates a local task manifest, limits fan-out, preserves
partial outcomes, and delegates every attempt to ``dispatch_run.py``. It does
not schedule future work or create a second lifecycle ledger.

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --run-dir RUN_DIR
  --manifest MANIFEST
  --concurrency CONCURRENCY

Manifest schema v1: {"schema_version":1,"tasks":[{"id":"task-1","prompt_file":"prompt.md","adapter":"codex","alias":"junior","role":"worker"}]}.
Each task uses ordinary intent and exactly one of prompt_file/prompt plus one
route selector (alias, task_class or model). Tasks default to read_only access;
a task may set access_mode worktree_write with a worktree it owns exclusively, and
two tasks may never name the same worktree. Agy tasks may also name a run-owned
git_evidence packet.
